title: Nutty Middle Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful lamb stew featuring condensed milk and a blend of Middle Eastern spices, cooked to perfection over binchotan charcoal for a romantic dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides
Add the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Add the chopped almonds and dried apricots, and stir to combine
Pour in the condensed milk and bring the mixture to a simmer
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the binchotan charcoal grill
Cook the tagine over low heat for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro
